units: a main tap = 1; delays in integer device samples from the input; mono in, (L, R) out

value.note: plain taps, no diffuser, gains on the EARLY law at law_tick x 4 ms

branch_delay.note: the whole AP(124) branch (main taps and late) sits this many samples after the table positions re the front taps: the captures' modal offset; with it R's first tap (464 + 1) is where its direct term was measured (465), so no special case is needed

value.R_first_tap: in captures whose branch is jittered its direct term stays at 465 (§9.4); none at branch = 1

value.between_steps: H: a stage runs if its last tap is at least 15-33 ms before SPAN

value.positive: stage j at tau = 16 + 36 j ms, front taps at their tick; gain -60 tau / EARLY dB
value.negative: last stage at tau_end = SPAN + 12 ms, others 36 ms apart before it; gain +60 (tau - tau_end) / |EARLY| dB

value.gain: EARLY > 0: the early law at stage min(ns, 13) (tau = 16 + 36 min(ns, 13) ms); EARLY < 0 or 10: 0 dB

loops.form: line[n] = v[n] + G line[n - P], G = 10^(-3 P / (fs LATE)), no filter

value.late_0: LATE 0: no late section at all (gated)

value.form: none: the plugin's N output is flat to the 12.8 kHz analysis edge
value.note: the -0.24 / -1.03 / -1.85 / -3.0 dB roll-off at 11.5 / 12 / 12.3 / 12.6 kHz that 11.3 first adopted as an EQ is the harness's own 96 kHz -> device-rate resampler (resample_poly 25/91, Kaiser 5; -0.22 / -0.90 / -1.50 / -2.33 / -3.65 dB at 11.5 / 12 / 12.25 / 12.5 / 12.8 kHz, nl_structure.resampler_gain), not a property of the unit: refitted after the clock warp was fixed it matches that filter to 0.05 dB up to 12 kHz. The LOW PASS therefore needs no special 12 kHz shape on N. (The plugin's low-band CaptureEq is the separate model_s_results 27 transfer.) The band-edge term above 10 kHz that the bench applies per capture run (NonLin_program 11.6, hf_corr_g5.json) belongs to the capture chain, not to this spec.

value.use: kernel = delta + strength * (taps - delta), per channel (the stored taps are the fitted, strength 1 kernel)
value.applies_to: the whole AP(124) branch (main taps, R's first-tap direct term, late section); not the front taps
value.reference_irs: kernel-free: analysis/nl/ref/*.wav come from simulate(), which omits this kernel. Null a kernel-on port with the kernel bypassed, or expect about -59 dB worst on these six settings (-62 dB median) against these files; the port's own reference should be rendered with the kernel and BK_PAD samples of look-ahead (nl_model.render applies it zero-latency via a -BK_PAD roll)
value.status: adopted (27 Oct 2026; refitted and set to strength 0.7 under the long-kernel clock warp, NonLin_program 11.5-11.6): 0.05-0.15 / 0.15-0.3 / 0.3-0.6 s medians -58.7 / -57.6 / -52.2 dB (1,044 captures held out; the 0.65 kernel on the old warp gave -58.4 / -57.3 / -52.0), no channel-window worse than the previous adopted bench by more than +0.07 dB (0.0-0.6 s); against the same bench without the kernel the worst loss is +0.81 dB (22 channel-windows over +0.5 at 0.05-0.15 s, plus 2+2 at 0.15-0.3 / 0.3-0.6 s); the strength-0.5 screen used a 151-capture subset and was not benched in full; the medians mix L and R
value.note: deviations from a unit tap are <= 0.00073 (-62.8 dB): inaudible, only for null-level fidelity; centred, so a plugin needs BK_PAD samples of look-ahead or the same delay on the front taps

branch_read_kernel.label: S (measured, held out) / H (cause: the main taps' read)

DELAY.value: a pure delay ahead of everything (card: DELAY precedes the early section); the library is all DELAY 0
DELAY.label: H

value.note: 16 values = the LF column's 16 steps; 10 means flat
RT = LATE exactly, flat in frequency; 0 = no late; 11 values (the HF column has 10 steps in S)

LOW PASS.label: C (card) / H (response)

per_capture_only: branch offset o = 1 in the plugin/reference IRs (0 = the bench frame), front-tap trim shift, clock, gain
cost_per_sample: per channel: 3 front + up to 27 main taps, 4 all-passes total (AP124 shared; AP180 L / AP188 R; AP314), 3 loops, 12 reads

references.note: device rate (the exact device_rate_hz; the WAV header is the integer 26,374 Hz), float32, (L, R), input impulse at sample 0, main-tap units; kernel-free and branch = 1. validation.note: simulate() = the bench model to -136 dB on these settings (nl_model.render, band=False, proc=False, branch = 1)
